subject: Tenant activation and API key seeding plan for Clearwind Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara@clearwind.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant activation and API key seeding plan for Clearwind Health

Hi Sara —

Congrats again on the signed agreement. To keep momentum we want to align on the initial tenant activation and how we’ll seed API credentials for your integration team. I’ve attached a short activation checklist and a roles template that maps to Redwood's project-level permissions.

Proposed high-level plan:  
- Day 0 (today): Customer signs off on admin list + SC/MA approval (I attached the scanned approval if you have it).
- Day 1: Redwood creates the tenant and seeds two API keys (one for integration dev, one for analytics).
- Day 2: Invite your three initial users and map roles per the attached CSV.
- Day 3: Integration smoke test and access verification.

Can you confirm the admin list and whether the keys should be scoped to a single project or separate projects per environment? If you prefer, we can create a staging and production project and seed keys accordingly.

Action items for Clearwind:
- Reply with admin names/emails (or confirm that Marco and Sara are the org admins).
- Confirm whether to use separate projects for staging/prod.

I’ve looped in Dev (implementation lead) and Marissa (solutions) to own the activation tasks.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant-activation-checklist.xlsx, activation-roles-template.csv
From: Sara Jensen <sara@clearwind.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@clearwind.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation and API key seeding plan for Clearwind Health

Kimberly —

Thanks, this looks good. We’ve completed the internal MA and approved the activation (attached). Confirming admins: Sara Jensen (sara@clearwind.com) and Marco Li (marco.li@clearwind.com).

We’d like separate projects for staging and production. Staging will be used by our integration squad (dev@clearwind.com) — we’ll provide a short list of three staging users. Production admins will be Sara and Marco.

Two quick asks:  
1) Can you seed keys with a tag that indicates environment (e.g., cw-staging, cw-prod)?  
2) Are there limits or recommended TTLs you want us to follow for the integration key?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aiming to start smoke tests on Monday.

Best,
Sara Jensen
Director of Product Engineering
Clearwind Health

Attachment: clearwind-ma-approval.pdf
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Sara Jensen <sara@clearwind.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation and API key seeding plan for Clearwind Health

Thanks Sara and Kim — I’ll own the tenant creation and key seeding. A couple of practical details I need to proceed:  

- Exact list of staging users (email addresses) to invite — please send the CSV or confirm inline. The roles template maps the three typical roles we use: org_admin, project_admin, integration_developer.
- Confirm whether the staging integration key should be restricted to IP allowlist (we can lock to your CI IPs) or left broad for initial testing.
- Key rotation policy: We recommend 90 days TTL for integration keys and we can set automated rotation with a short overlap window. If you need longer, we can make it 180 days but would enable rotation reminders.

Planned schedule: Create tenant + projects (staging/prod) on 2027-09-02 AM, seed keys and send credentials by 2027-09-02 18:00 PT, invite users on 2027-09-03 09:00 PT, and run smoke tests 2027-09-03 13:00 PT.

If that works, I’ll kick off the tenant create this morning and post the activation logs to the HubSpot deal and the shared Drive link.

—Dev
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821
From: Marco Li <marco.li@clearwind.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jensen <sara@clearwind.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation and API key seeding plan for Clearwind Health

Dev —

Thanks for the schedule. Quick answers:  
- Staging user list attached (three users).
- Please restrict the staging key to our CI IP range: 34.120.12.0/24 and 34.120.20.0/24 for now. We’ll open the production key to only our office IPs later.
- 90 days TTL is fine. Please enable rotation reminders two weeks before expiry.

We’ll be available for the smoke test on Friday at 13:00 PT.

—Marco
Senior Engineering Manager
Clearwind Health

Attachment: clearwind-staging-users.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara@clearwind.com>, Marco Li <marco.li@clearwind.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation and API key seeding plan for Clearwind Health

All —

Great, we’re set. Summary of confirmed actions and owners:  
- Dev: Create tenant and two projects (cw-staging, cw-prod) and seed keys tagged cw-staging / cw-prod; restrict staging key to CI IP ranges provided; enable 90-day TTL + rotation reminders. (ETA: 2027-09-02 done — logs posted)
- Marissa: Send onboarding runbook and invite checklist to the staging users (sent).
- Kimberly: Confirmed admins and will follow up on any billing questions with finance.
- Clearwind: Run smoke tests 2027-09-03 13:00 PT and confirm success.

Next steps: Dev has posted the activation log to the HubSpot deal and Drive; I’ll mark the HubSpot stage to Implementation. If any of you hit issues during the smoke test, reply-all and we’ll triage.

Thanks everyone — welcome aboard Clearwind!

Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/clearwind-activation-4821
